titleZh: Filing: Leopold Aschenbrenner的对冲基金重新加仓AI股票
titleOriginal: Filing: Leopold Aschenbrenner's hedge fund Situational Awareness, after nearly blowing up, loaded back up on AI stocks at the end of Q3; all have since plunged (Sean Conlon/CNBC)
summary: Leopold Aschenbrenner的AI主题对冲基金Situational Awareness在Q3末重新加仓AI股票，但此后所有持仓均已下跌。该基金曾在七月近乎崩盘，后重新加仓后出现回撤。
keyPoints: 对冲基金Situational Awareness在Q3末重新加仓AI股票
加仓后股票均已下跌，曾在七月近乎崩盘
基金管理人Leopold Aschenbrenner曾因业绩波动备受关注
